M2a_physical_persistence.caption: Global annotated persistence and camera projected-in-view persistence use separate sets and different denominators; the curve gap is not a decomposition. Scene-equal pair means; 95% scene-bootstrap intervals; n counts pairs with a nonempty initial set, summed over gaps in each legend. Actual mean sample gaps are shown; camera exposure gaps are recorded separately.
M2a_physical_persistence.pdf: Vector axes/text; real camera photographs are embedded raster

M2b_image_displacement.caption: Same official instance ID, same camera and scene, valid projections at both times. Boxes: pooled 25–75%, median; whiskers: 5–95%. Orange diamonds: scene-equal means with 95% scene-bootstrap intervals. n is camera-pair instance observations; repeated temporal pairs, repeated instances and cross-camera projections are dependent.
M2b_image_displacement.pdf: Vector axes/text; real camera photographs are embedded raster

M2c_ego_motion_displacement.caption: Time-gap strata; approximately static means global annotation-center speed ≤0.5 m/s over actual sample timestamps. Scatter is seeded and independently capped at 1,200 observations per group, so it does not encode group frequency; binned summaries use all rows. X medians count each unique camera pair once; y is scene-equal displacement mean with 95% scene-bootstrap intervals. S labels give scenes per bin; open markers denote one-scene bins without CIs. Dashed segments connect bin summaries, not a fitted causal response. Associations do not establish ego-only causation.
M2c_ego_motion_displacement.pdf: Vector axes/text; real camera photographs are embedded raster

M2d_grid_overlap.caption: Approximately static annotated objects only: global annotation-center speed ≤0.5 m/s over actual sample timestamps. Main rule any: positive-area box/cell intersection. Grids are diagnostic image regions, not CLIP tokens. X medians count unique camera pairs once; y is scene-equal Jaccard mean with 95% scene-bootstrap intervals. S labels count scenes per bin; open markers denote singleton-scene bins without CIs. Grid variants share the same underlying observations and are not independent objects. Dashed segments connect bin summaries.
M2d_grid_overlap.pdf: Vector axes/text; real camera photographs are embedded raster
